name: Canonical Single Result Contract

metrics.minClearanceMm: Float64 (>= 0.0, Infinity if disjoint without bound)

fields.positionWCS: { x: Float64, y: Float64, z: Float64 }
fields.normalWCS: { x: Float64, y: Float64, z: Float64 } (Unit vector pointing from BodyB to BodyA)

temporalInfo.timeOfImpactNormalized: Float64 (0.0 to 1.0 along trajectory, null if static)

invariantRules: status === 'NO_COLLISION' REQUIRES metrics.maxPenetrationDepthMm === 0.0 AND metrics.minClearanceMm >= safeMargin
status in ['ANALYSIS_FAILED', 'INVALID_GEOMETRY', 'UNKNOWN'] MUST set severity to at least 'ERROR'
Exceptions or unhandled kernel states MUST NEVER return status === 'NO_COLLISION'
